C0659.title: Wang Sentenced for Disrupting Bidding Order Through Malicious Complaints
C0659.summary: From late 2021 to June 2022, Wang controlled multiple companies to bid on government procurement projects, then delayed the bidding process by sending complaint letters. He used this to extort money from competitors or force them to purchase his goods at inflated prices, only withdrawing complaints after they complied. Wang was sentenced to 15 years in prison for extortion and other crimes.
